title: Extract one approved NARA census batch -> corpus (provenance + evidence)
context: This is the proof-of-pipeline task for M1: taking one approved NARA census batch through the full extraction, deceased-determination, normalization, and provenance/evidence-binding pipeline to produce the first real corpus records. The batch must use a NARA-served digitization (not a Fold3/Ancestry copy) with the 72-year rule satisfied. Every person must pass the deceased-determination engine. Every assertion must carry a resolvable page/image-level provenance citation and a GPS evidence rationale. Conflicting source statements (e.g., disagreeing ages across census years) must be retained with separate provenance rather than flattened.
objective: Run one approved NARA census batch through the full extraction pipeline (extractor + deceased-determination engine + normalization + provenance/evidence binding) to produce GEDCOM X-aligned Person/Name/Fact/Relationship/Source records in the corpus, with 100% provenance and 100% evidence rationale on every assertion, passing all CI gates before review.
acceptanceCriteria: Records from one approved NARA census batch (NARA-served; 72-year rule satisfied; allow-list status 'approved') mapped to Person/Name/Fact/Relationship/SourceDescription nodes in the corpus.
100% of new assertions carry a resolvable page/image-level provenance link to the NARA-served source document.
100% of new assertions carry a GPS evidence rationale (Conclusion note recording what supports the assertion and how any conflict was resolved).
Conflicting source statements (e.g., disagreeing ages across census records) retained with separate provenance entries; no single-winner conclusion without a sourced rationale.
All persons in the batch pass the deceased-determination engine; zero living persons are admitted.
Passes all CI gates (SHACL + provenance + evidence + no-SSN/DMF/genetic + deceased-only + allow-list) before the PR is submitted for review.
Batch committed to corpus/ via PR with an extraction summary documenting: source, record count, deceased/excluded/suppressed counts, and CI gate results.
output: corpus/<batch-id>/ directory containing GEDCOM X JSON records for the extracted batch plus an extraction-summary.md, committed via PR.
